svg.title: Review cycles stored in T or in source C channels
svg.desc: Illustrative source organization, not measured image data. The upper lane has two T positions, each containing C0, C1 and C2. The researcher confirms that T represents imaging cycles and that the cycles are already registered. T0 supplies cycle 1 and T1 supplies cycle 2. The lower lane has one T position containing C0 through C5 in source order. The Recorded row shows explicit per-channel cycle metadata: C0, C2 and C4 have cycle 1; C1 and C5 have cycle 2; C3 has no recorded cycle. The researcher manually enters cycle 2 for C3 using imaging notes. The Reviewed row retains the five recorded values and shows C3 as an outlined editable field with the manually entered 2. C0, C2 and C4 therefore form cycle 1, and C1, C3 and C5 form cycle 2. Source C order alone does not determine cycle membership. Both lanes retain the original source addresses and yield reviewed cycle groups; marker and fluorophore assignments are not part of this diagram. The numbered badges indicate one-based source-row positions, not raw C coordinates. Raw C and T addresses are zero based and remain attached to the same plane cards in the grouped view. All illustrated planes have Z0. Neutral source thumbnails do not imply cycle identity or registration.
svg.text: One T position, cycles within C
